Observations:
Perturb(A) -> A:0 B:1 C:1 D:1 E:1 F:1
Perturb(C) -> A:0 B:0 C:0 D:1 E:0 F:1
Perturb(E) -> A:0 B:1 C:1 D:1 E:0 F:1
Candidates:
1. Graph: A->B, A->E, C->D, C->F, E->B, E->C
2. Graph: A->C, A->E, C->D, C->F, E->B, E->C
3. Graph: A->D, A->E, C->D, C->F, E->B, E->C
4. Graph: A->E, A->F, C->D, C->F, E->B, E->C
5. Graph: A->E, C->D, C->F, E->B
6. Graph: A->E, C->D, C->F, E->C
7. Graph: A->E, C->D, E->B, E->C
8. Graph: A->E, C->F, E->B, E->C
